reviews.text: We unfortunately had to put our cat of 16 years to sleep. The staff here were very loving and caring and supportive during that difficult time. Highly recommend 🙏 …

I brought my cat in for a check-up due to ongoing coughing and asthma, which had been previously diagnosed by another vet. My old vet’s office recently closed, so I decided to come here.

I had actually been to this clinic before with my cat, but when I called to schedule the appointment, they said there was no record of us in the system. That was a bit surprising, especially since I had filled out a lot of paperwork during my first visit—it felt like that information should still be there.

This visit was mainly to discuss the best medications and treatment options for my cat’s asthma. The vet recommended X-rays and blood work, which were estimated to cost around $500, but my final bill ended up being about $800. That felt quite expensive to me, though I’m hopeful the treatment plan will help my cat feel better.

I’ll update this review once I see how my cat responds to the treatment and will share any progress.

Update on September 2026:

Called to get medication for my cat! She has asthma so there is no cure only steroids for her. When I brought her here first time I told my previous vet established she has asthma. They told me here they need to run all the tests again. So we did! And this vet established she has asthma so I payed 2 times to get her diagnosed with condition that can't be cured!

I called 2 days ago because Gray started coughing again then they said “they need to diagnose her again to give me medications 😂😂

This clinic is scam please don't bring your pet here

From then on I had vets who didn't check my cat's chart or keep track of the severity of his condition, and people who were not skilled/experienced enough to accurately read results or make diagnoses. One of them misdiagnosed my cat with diabetes, leading to us buying and giving him meds he didn't need that he obviously had a negative reaction to, and which we had to take him to an expensive emergency vet to get treatement for. He died shortly after that. I know he had been sick with chronic conditions and his time was running out anyway, but I do feel that they hastened his end with their incompetence. Would never go back here and I strongly urge others to go elsewhere.

I was looking for a provider that loved cats because some providers have biases about cats. As a cat owner, she understood the complexities of caring for them. She cared for him up until he passed in January. I have a new baby, my Shih Tzu-Poodle mix. He’s 10 weeks old. Even though I have moved out of the area, I knew she would be the doctor for my baby. The staff here has always been supportive, professional and friendly. The office prices aren’t outrageous and they are upfront with all costs. I would definitely recommend.

Edit: I had to come back to edit my post. It wouldn’t be fair for those looking for a vet to be unaware of an ongoing issue…the front desk. Consistently the staff that is working, the front desk has been cold, Unprofessional, Unhelpful, Rude, and on many occasions have blatantly ignored requests for medical documents. I have absolutely no complaints with my fur babie’s provider, but it is very difficult to get to her because of the rudeness of the front desk. Front desk is not there to turn away patients. Also, there shouldn’t be any sarcastic remarks coming from them regarding bills or pet names. I love, love, love Dr. Fitzgerald, but I can’t continue to consider this place as a source for medical care when more than half of the staff here doesn’t care about providing medical care.
